---
title: OmicIDX
description: SRA, GEO, BioSample, and BioProject metadata as Parquet files you can query from DuckDB, Python, or R. Rebuilt nightly. No account, no key.
toc: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
# Explicit: duckdb's extension autoinstall fails on fresh CI runners.
DBI::dbExecute(con, "INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs; INSTALL json; LOAD json;")
```

[Get the data](guides/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .me-2 .mb-2}
[Try it in your browser](playground.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .me-2 .mb-2}
[View on GitHub](https://github.com/seandavi/omicidx){.btn .btn-link .mb-2}

```{sql}
-- DuckDB: no download, no credentials
ATTACH 'https://omicidx.cancerdatasci.org/data/latest/omicidx.duckdb' AS omicidx (READ_ONLY);
SELECT run_accession, study_title FROM omicidx.sradb.rnaseq_runs WHERE taxon_id = 9606 LIMIT 10;
```

::: {.grid .mt-4}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-3}
#### Get the data {.mt-0}

Everything lives under `https://omicidx.cancerdatasci.org/data/`. Query it
in place with [DuckDB](guides/duckdb-snapshot.qmd), or use the
[Python and R recipes](guides/index.qmd). [Releases](releases.qmd) lists
every version, its tables and sizes.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-3}
#### Use it from R {.mt-0}

The [omicidxr](guides/r-omicidxr.qmd) package connects in one line, pins a
version, and replaces SRAdb and GEOmetadb.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-3}
#### Cite a release {.mt-0}

Monthly releases on HuggingFace carry a git tag and a DOI. Download one and
query it locally. See [Versions and citation](guides/versions-and-citation.qmd).
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-3}
#### Try it in your browser {.mt-0}

The [playground](playground.qmd) runs SQL against `latest/` with
DuckDB-Wasm, and every SQL example in these docs opens in the DuckDB Shell.
Nothing to install.
:::

:::
